'''''Full Throttle''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It depicted a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] rider.<ref name="Missing" />

==Behind the scenes==
This poster was painted by [[Amy Beth Christenson]], and was developed for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Missing in Action]]." It is one of several posters based on classic [[LucasArts]] [[Wikipedia:Adventure game|adventure games]], but done with a ''Star Wars'' twist. This poster is based on the computer adventure game [[Wikipedia:Full Throttle (1995 video game)|''Full Throttle'']].<ref name="SW-Missing in Action Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/missing-in-action-trivia-gallery|text="Missing in Action" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>
